draft.subject: Photographing the Boreal Quartet at Metro Concert Hall.
draft.body: It was good connecting about the Boreal Quartet at Metro Concert Hall on July 12, and I'd love to photograph it. I shoot unobtrusive, no-flash documentary coverage that suits a concert program, and recent work is at danwrightphotography.com. My rate is $250 an hour plus tax, one-hour minimum, with the gallery delivered within two weeks. Happy to answer any questions.
